text: Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I: Or, that Israel may be gathered to him, and I may etc.
it is a light thing that thou shouldst: Or, art thou lighter, then that thou shouldest etc. | preserved: Or, desolations
to him whom man despiseth: Or, to him that is despised in soul
that she should not have compassion: Heb. from having compassion
nursing fathers: Heb. nourishers | queens: Heb. Princesses
the lawful captive: Heb. the captivity of the just
